delete.body: Removes the domain from {{app}} entirely. Type the domain to confirm.
delete.dropsSettings: Deleting removes this domain's own settings: WAF and rate limit, own certificate and basic auth are dropped.

attach.title: Attach {{domain}}
attach.body: Choose the app that should serve this parked domain.
attach.dropsWarning: Static sites have no per-domain settings. The saved settings for this domain will be dropped, not restored.

deleteParked.title: Delete parked domain {{domain}}?
deleteParked.body: Forgets the domain and its parked DNS and certificate state. Type the domain to confirm.

parked.title: Parked
parked.hint: Registered but routed by no app. Attach one to an app to serve it again.

provider.generic: Add this record where you manage your domain's DNS, usually your registrar or hosting provider.
provider.cloudflare: Your DNS looks like it is on Cloudflare. Add the record there and turn the orange cloud off until the certificate is issued.
provider.route53: Your DNS looks like it is on Amazon Route 53. Add the record in the hosted zone for this domain.
provider.godaddy: Your DNS looks like it is on GoDaddy. Add the record under DNS records for this domain.
provider.namecheap: Your DNS looks like it is on Namecheap. Add the record under Advanced DNS.
provider.google: Your DNS looks like it is on Google Cloud DNS. Add the record in this domain's zone.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.body: Move this domain to another app, park it, or remove it. Visitors lose this address while it is away.

waf.helpDetect: Requests matching OWASP CRS rules are logged, never rejected. Switch to Block once you have reviewed logs for false positives.
waf.helpBlock: Requests matching OWASP CRS rules are rejected with an error.
waf.rpsHelp: 0 disables rate limiting for this domain.
waf.burstHelp: Requests allowed in a single second beyond the sustained rate above. Leave at 0 for a strict cap.

bulk.blockedAutomatic: Automatic hostnames cannot be parked or moved
bulk.blockedStandalone: Standalone domains cannot be parked or moved

body.park: Each domain stops being served by its app and moves to the Parked group.
body.move: Choose where these domains should go. A collision check runs first.
body.attach: Choose the app or static site that should serve these parked domains.
body.delete_parked: Forgets these domains and their parked DNS and certificate state. This cannot be undone.

bulk.parkKeeps: Settings are saved with each parked domain, and DNS and certificate state are kept.
bulk.discard: Start fresh and discard saved settings

status.needsConfirmationBody: Traffic for this domain changes owner. Confirm to continue.

retention.title: Auto cleanup
retention.summaryOff: Off. Parked domains are kept until you delete them.
retention.summaryOn: Deletes parked domains after {{days}} days. Due now: {{due}}. Next run: {{next}}
retention.previewBody: See which parked domains a retention period would delete.
retention.estimate: Estimate from the parked list. The exact list is shown once cleanup is on.
retention.exact: Exact list from the server for the saved setting.
retention.batchNote: Each hourly run deletes at most {{limit}}, oldest first. The rest follow in later runs.
retention.confirmBody: {{due}} due now, {{first}} deleted in the first run (batch limit {{limit}}).
retention.consequenceDns: Only the parked registration is deleted. DNS records and certificates are not touched.
retention.consequenceBatch: At most {{limit}} domains are deleted per hourly run, oldest first.
retention.offBody: Parked domains will be kept until you delete them. Nothing is deleted by turning this off.

reachability.title: Reachability
reachability.forbidden: You need read access to see the reachability check.
reachability.errorTitle: Could not run the reachability check
reachability.errorBody: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.
reachability.dialbackOn: Internet check is on: a helper service dials this server's public IP and your open ports from outside.
reachability.dialbackOff: Internet check is off, so only local checks ran. Turning it on sends this server's public IP and its port list to the URL you set in doctor.reachability_dialback_url.

rollback.minutesLeft_one: Can be rolled back for {{count}} more minute
rollback.minutesLeft_other: Can be rolled back for {{count}} more minutes
rollback.hoursLeft_one: Can be rolled back for {{count}} more hour
rollback.hoursLeft_other: Can be rolled back for {{count}} more hours
rollback.consequenceRemove: Records this change added are removed.
rollback.consequenceRestore: Records this change replaced get their old value back.
rollback.consequenceSkip: Records edited since are left alone.

deploy.title: Deploy an app
deploy.body: A domain points at an app, so deploy one first.

domain.title: Add your domain
domain.body: Point your own web address at the app.

https.title: Turn on HTTPS
https.body: Certificates are issued for you once HTTPS is on.

www.title: www address
www.help: Make {{domain}} and www.{{domain}} both work, with one redirect.
www.error: We could not read the DNS plan: {{message}}
www.noProvider: No DNS provider is connected for this domain. Add these records where you manage DNS, then check again.
www.replaceWarning: A different record already exists. Applying will replace it.
www.applied: Done. Both addresses are set up.
www.connectPointsHere: www.{{domain}} already points to this server but is not connected to this app. Connect it and send www visitors to {{domain}}.
www.connectNeedsDns: www.{{domain}} is not connected to this app yet. Add this CNAME where you manage DNS, then check again.
www.connectedNoRedirect: www is connected to this app
www.connectDone: www is connected to this app.

links.deploys: App is not running, see deploys

readiness.title: Domain readiness
readiness.allDone: All set, no more checks needed.

dns.done: Your domain points at this server.
dns.progress: Waiting for DNS. Add the record shown above.
dns.blocked: The domain points somewhere else. Fix the record shown above.

cert.progress: Issuing your certificate, usually under a minute.
cert.blocked: Issuing failed. See the fix below.

site.done: Your site is answering over HTTPS.
site.progress: Waiting for the site to answer.
site.blocked: The site is not answering. See below.
site.waiting: Starts once the certificate is ready.

readiness.ttl: DNS changes can take up to {{time}} to reach everyone.
readiness.localLag: Public DNS is already right. This server's own resolver may lag a little, which does not stop your site.
readiness.issuing: Issuing your certificate. This page updates by itself.
readiness.issueFailed: The certificate could not be issued. Check that the record points here and port 80 is open, then press Check now.

route.404: The route answers 404, which means the server is reachable but does not know this domain yet.
route.503: The route answers 503, which means the server is reachable but the app behind it is not ready or not attached to this domain.
route.5xx: The route answers a server error, which means the server is reachable but the app behind it is failing. Check the app logs.

addWizard.advanced: Advanced: add several domains at once

step1.title: Which domain and which app?
step1.kindApex: This is a main domain. We will suggest connecting www too in the last step.
step1.kindSubdomain: This is a subdomain, it needs one record.

errors.empty: Type the domain you bought, for example example.com.
errors.invalid: That does not look like a domain. Use letters, numbers and dots, for example example.com.
errors.wildcard: A wildcard like *.example.com needs the advanced form. Use the link below, or type a single domain.
errors.claimedHere: This app already uses that domain. Pick another domain or open it from the list.
errors.claimedOther: The app {{app}} already uses that domain. Remove it there first, or pick another domain.
errors.noApp: Choose the app this domain should open.
errors.addFailed: We could not add the domain: {{message}}. Check the name and try again.

step2.title: Point your domain here
step2.intro: Add this record where you bought {{domain}}. It tells the internet to send visitors to your server.
step2.name: Name
step2.noRecords: We could not find this server's public address. Open Domains settings and set the server address, then come back.
step2.providerOn: A DNS provider is connected, so we can add this record for you.
step2.providerOff: No DNS provider is connected. Add the record by hand at your registrar, it takes a minute to copy, then continue. Nothing is changed for you.
step2.applied: Record added. It can take a few minutes to spread.
step2.applyFailed: We could not add the record: {{message}}. Add it by hand with the values above, or check the provider connection.

step3.title: Going live
step3.waiting: We check again by ourselves. You can leave this open.
step3.doneBody: Visitors can open your site over HTTPS.
step3.wwwBody: Visitors often type www. One click connects it and sends them to {{domain}}.
